title: Saved engineering interfaces inherit Wright theme and reconnect their frame
summary: Actual settings controls and saved model-created interfaces; no process start, review or global preference save.

manualSteps.label: Open interface
manualSteps.instruction: Open the saved Heat or Focus-wheel working-interface link.

manualSteps.label: Choose light theme
manualSteps.instruction: Click Back to Dashboard, then Settings. Choose Light Theme. Leave Save Preferences untouched.

manualSteps.label: Return to interface
manualSteps.instruction: Use browser Back twice to return to the saved working interface.

manualSteps.label: Reload frame
manualSteps.instruction: Reload the embedded page using the browser frame-reload action. Inspect the same exact results.

manualSteps.label: Restore theme
manualSteps.instruction: Repeat the Settings route, choose Dark Theme, then return. Leave all reviews unchanged.

steps.label: heat saved working interface
steps.summary: The exact saved revision and engineering outputs are connected.
steps.purpose: Establish the real scoped working context.
steps.expected: Exact saved revision and current results.
steps.actual: 18 exact results in the current working context.

steps.label: heat light theme matches Wright
steps.summary: The saved isolated interface inherits Wright’s selected light theme.
steps.purpose: Check actual host theme transmission, not a screenshot-only approximation.
steps.action: Open Settings, choose Light Theme without saving preferences, and use browser Back twice.
steps.expected: Frame background/text theme tokens and color scheme match its parent.

steps.label: heat embedded page reconnects
steps.summary: The same presentation reconnects after its frame document reloads.
steps.purpose: Verify re-armed exact host handshake and current run binding.
steps.action: Reload the embedded page using the browser frame-reload operation.
steps.expected: Fresh frame handshake, same saved UI/run/results and selected light theme.
steps.actual: New context read and 18 exact result identities restored; theme retained.

steps.label: heat dark theme restored
steps.summary: Wright’s selected dark theme is restored without changing engineering work.
steps.purpose: Verify both supported theme values and no saved preference mutation.
steps.action: Use Settings to choose Dark Theme, then return through browser Back.
steps.expected: Exact dark parent/frame theme and unchanged outputs.

steps.label: wheel saved working interface
steps.summary: The exact saved revision and engineering outputs are connected.
steps.purpose: Establish the real scoped working context.
steps.expected: Exact saved revision and current results.
steps.actual: 19 exact results in the current working context.

steps.label: Theme/handshake check stopped
steps.summary: The first unexpected interface behavior is preserved.
steps.purpose: Keep the real failure and exact current theme values.
steps.action: Stop at the current saved interface.
steps.expected: Parent and saved interface have the same selected theme and exact run context.
